correctness.rationale: Original-time dynamics is F_B(X,Y)=(Y+max(0,2X),B-max(0,2X)), with scale B removed by normalization. On the canonical arclength segment r in (0,1], direct piecewise iteration (also published primary itinerary) splits R=(0,1/16], U=(1/16,1/8), G=[1/8,1]. G has length 14/16 and hits c0 at time 6; R has length 1/16 and hits c0 at time 7; U returns after exactly seven original updates via r->16r-1, bijectively onto the entire interval. Thus survivor cylinders have exact measure 16^-k, and disjoint exits have probabilities 14/16^(k+1), 1/16^(k+1) at times 7k+6,7k+7. Both exits land c0, giving the two phase atoms with limiting weights 14/15,1/15. At n=7q+m, uncaptured non-atomic mass is exactly 16^-q for m<=5 or 2*16^(-q-1) for m=6; captured masses are componentwise bounded by phase limits, so total-variation equals that residual. The null exceptional endpoints do not affect probabilities. Independently checked exact rational iterations, 7-cycle and renewal lengths. No inference from finite k to the infinite law is needed, since the inverse branch is an exact affine bijection.
